description: This file defines a plugin function for processing quiz sections within a markdown abstract syntax tree (mdast). It extracts quiz questions, distractors, answers, and optional audio data, converting them into a structured format and attaching it to the file data.

methods.name: plugin
methods.description: Main function that returns the transformer function for processing the markdown AST.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Processes the AST to extract quizzes, questions, distractors, answers, and optional audio data, and attaches the structured quizzes to the file data.

methods.name: getDistractors
methods.description: Splits distractor nodes into three groups and converts each group to HTML.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Constructs a question object with text, distractors, answer, and optional audio data, validating the presence and structure of each component.
